sub_indicators.label: AI in administration
sub_indicators.subject: tech.ai
sub_indicators.text: Use of AI in government administration: AI in administration
sub_indicators.norm_short: The Continental AI Strategy asks for AI adopted in the public sector under a governance framework, with innovation-friendly procurement and use cases shared and reported.
criteria: A source from the past three years says no AI system is in use in public administration.
A government body has tendered, piloted or is testing an AI system for its own work or its services.
A government body uses an AI system in service, such as a chatbot for a public service or AI processing documents.
AI systems are in service in two or more government bodies, or one government-wide AI platform serves several.
The government's authority for cross-government digital governance has issued rules for government bodies' use or purchase of AI, or published a register of the government's AI systems.
